description: Scrapy, a fast high-level web crawling & scraping framework for Python.

latest_release.body:
- Web-browser-like detection of response encodings, base URLs and meta refresh redirects, powered by [frostwork](https://github.com/scrapy/frostwork)
- Requests can be awaited to get their response
- Non-asyncio Twisted reactors are deprecated

[Full changelog](https://docs.scrapy.org/en/latest/news.html#release-2-20-0)
